chapter: New York, Henderson and Charlie Johnson
title: Playing Marie's restaurant on 69th Street and dance dates in Pennsylvania
summary: The band worked at Marie's, a big restaurant catering to college crowds, and toured Pennsylvania dances.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Was this a traveling band, Herman, or did you stay in --
Oh yes. Well, when I met them, and joined them, they were working out of the club, outside of Philly's, the 69th Street, a place called Marie's, Marie's now. Well,

it was a restaurant, a huge place, and very, very, very nice. They catered to most all of the college crowds usually, football games, and things, would come around there, and you -- they would come in, and they'd go -- they got to go to Marie's, got to go to Marie's. You know?
And that's where they was, and we worked there, and we applied the music for the dancing. I'm trying to think now just what else. That's about it. And --
When you went on the road, where did you go?
Well when we went -- when we did go on the road we went to -- through Pennsylvania, and up Harrisburg, and all that business, around, and there, you know.
Were you playing dances, or were you --
